instructions: Heat the oven to 375°F. Bring a large pot of water to a boil.
Add the salt to the boiling water, then the rotini. Cook for 1 minute less than the package says, so it's still a little firm. Drain well.
Meanwhile, slice the bell pepper into thin strips and drain the olives.

In a large bowl, combine the rotini, marinara, pepper, olives, half of the pepperoni, the Italian seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, 3/4 cup of the mozzarella and 1/4 cup of the Parmesan. Stir until well mixed.
Taste a piece of rotini. If it's flat, add a pinch more salt.
Spoon it into a 2 1/2 quart baking dish, about 8 by 11 inches. Sprinkle on the remaining mozzarella and Parmesan, then lay the rest of the pepperoni on top.
Bake uncovered for 25 to 30 minutes, until the cheese is golden and bubbly. Let it sit for 5 minutes before you scoop.
method_notes: Lead is Compston Kitchen (5.0 from 66): rotini in marinara with pepperoni, bell peppers and olives, baked under mozzarella and Parmesan. Two Healthy Kitchens (4.4 from 63) bakes uncooked pasta in sauce and water under foil; Barefeet in the Kitchen and Family Fresh Meals add browned Italian sausage. Scaled to 4 servings. The peppers and olives are in the lead and can be left out to keep it mild; sausage can go in for a loaded version.
